article.title: Mining in contemporary African underdevelopment (Editorial issue 189)
article.author: Editor
article.content: Bettina Engels and Elisa Greco argue that the green ‘transition’ does not represent a break with capitalism but a renewal of its old extractivist logic, turning Africa into a source of cheap labour and critical minerals for the Global North’s efforts to decarbonise, digitalise and militarise its economies. The post Mining in contemporary African underdevelopment (Editorial issue 189) appeared first on MR Online .
